transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hello, doctor. I'm here because I've been feeling persistently depressed and sad for a very long time now. It's been going on almost constantly for about two and a half years, and I just can't seem to shake this heavy mood.
Did these symptoms start after a specific stressful life event or major change? If so, what happened?
I honestly can't recall any specific stressful event or major change that triggered this. It just seemed to build up gradually, and I've been feeling this way for about two years and five months now.

During these past two and a half years, have there been any periods lasting 2 months or longer when you felt mostly back to normal? Or has the depressed mood been there nearly every day the whole time?

No, I haven't had any periods like that where I felt back to normal. The depressed mood has been there nearly every single day for the entire two years and five months. I don't think I've had even a few weeks of feeling okay, let alone two months.

During this time, have there been periods lasting at least 2 weeks when your depression got noticeably worse and you also had symptoms like loss of interest, sleep or appetite changes, low energy, poor concentration, guilt, or thoughts of death?

I'm not quite sure about that. My low mood has felt more like a constant, steady heaviness for the past two years and five months. I haven't really had distinct, severe two-week periods where things suddenly got much worse with those specific symptoms.

Along with the low mood, have you had at least two of these most days for the past two years: low energy, poor self-esteem, poor concentration, trouble sleeping, appetite changes, or feeling hopeless?

Yes, I've been dealing with this for about two and a half years now. Out of those, I definitely struggle heavily with sleep issues—like trouble falling asleep, waking up constantly, and feeling unrefreshed—and poor concentration, which makes it hard to focus or make decisions. I haven't noticed major changes in my appetite or self-esteem, but the sleep and focus problems have been very persistent.
Have you also had a clear loss of interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy for at least 2 weeks at a time, or has it mostly been a steady low mood without that kind of episode?

It has mostly been a steady, continuous low mood and sadness for the entire two and a half years. I haven't really had those distinct episodes of losing interest in things I usually enjoy. It just feels like a constant, unchanging heaviness every day.
Most days during these two and a half years, have you also felt hopeless or had very low energy along with the depressed mood?
I haven't really experienced hopelessness or low energy specifically during this time. I'm not sure about those symptoms, as my main struggle has just been the constant heavy mood itself.
Most days during these two and a half years, have you also had low self-esteem or often felt inadequate or down on yourself?
No, I haven't particularly struggled with low self-esteem or feeling inadequate. My view of myself has remained relatively normal despite the constant low mood.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient reports a depressed mood present nearly every day for about two years and five months without any symptom-free period lasting 2 months or longer. They also endorse two associated symptoms required for persistent depressive disorder: chronic sleep disturbance and poor concentration. There is no clear evidence of distinct major depressive episodes, and no specific psychosocial trigger was identified.
